wardDetail.title: Pennsylvania DOS precinct election returns bulk file
wardDetail.detail: The official bulk file includes precinct-level President and U.S. Senate rows. The state builder groups rows by county, precinct code, municipality, ward, and precinct breakdown fields for President-vs-Senate review graphs.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official readme says the data was extracted January 10, 2025; the direct bulk file name includes 20250129.

turnout.title: Pennsylvania DOS vote history and voter registration summary
